USPS® Direct Mail Templates

Download print-ready templates pre-formatted to USPS automation specifications. Each template includes proper barcode clear zones, address block positioning, and bleed areas.

These templates are used by businesses of all sizes running direct mail campaigns — from local retailers to nonprofits qualifying for reduced nonprofit postage rates. If you're not sure which size fits your budget, check our letter automation rates guide before you design.

What's included in every template

Every template is built to USPS automation specifications and exported in press-ready PDF format with CMYK color mode, proper bleed areas, and designated zones for barcode placement and address block positioning. Files are compatible with Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, and Photoshop. Postcard and flat templates are sized to meet USPS aspect ratio requirements, keeping your piece machinable and avoiding the nonmachinable surcharge. Need help with layout or artwork? Our graphic design team can customize any template for your campaign, and our commercial printing services produce press-ready pieces on the stock and finish you need.

Maintained by Sean Griffin, Owner — Cornerstone Services, Inc.

Sean has produced USPS-compliant direct mail for Hudson Valley businesses since 1998. These templates reflect the exact specifications Cornerstone applies to every print job — First-Class letters, Marketing Mail postcards, and EDDM flats processed through the USPS Business Mail Entry Unit (BMEU) in New Paltz, NY.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the USPS size requirements for EDDM flat cards?
EDDM flat cards must be at least 3.5″ × 6.25″ with a maximum of 12″ × 15″. Thickness must be between 0.007″ and 0.75″, and the aspect ratio (length÷height) must fall between 1.3 and 2.5. Every EDDM template in this library is built to these specifications. Current postage is $0.247 per piece at the EDDM Retail rate.
Do these templates include bleed areas and safety margins?
Yes. Every template includes a 1/8″ (0.125″) bleed area on all four sides, a cut line, and a 1/8″–1/4″ safety margin inside the live area to protect critical content from trimming. These match the bleed and safety specifications required by commercial printing presses.
How do I choose the right postage class for my mailpiece size?
Standard postcards (3.5″×5″ through 6″×9″) qualify for First-Class or Marketing Mail postcard rates. Flat-size pieces (6.5″×9″ and larger) mail at Marketing Mail flat or EDDM saturation rates. See our postage rates guide for current USPS First-Class, Marketing Mail, and EDDM pricing by piece size.
What software can I use to customize these PDF templates?
All templates are press-ready PDFs compatible with Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, and Photoshop. Most can also be imported into Canva using the PDF upload feature. If you need help with layout, logo placement, or copy, Cornerstone’s graphic design team can customize any template for your campaign.
Can Cornerstone print and mail pieces based on these templates?
Absolutely. Cornerstone Services handles the complete campaign — design customization, commercial printing, list procurement, and USPS delivery — from our New Paltz, NY facility. Request a free estimate and we’ll quote printing, postage, and fulfillment as a single package.
